text: ಅದ್ಭುತ ಟಿಪ್ಪಣಿ ಆಪ್. Easy, simple yet effective checklist app
author: ಆನಿಪ್ರಭ
developer_reply: Hi ವಿಶಾಖ ಬೋ ನಾ, thank you for the amazing review and 5-star rating for my little app. Your support means a lot to me. If you're able to please consider supporting my work with a donation or Premium account so I can continue development and keep Tasks advert free. Thanks, Steve
